丢弃后无法恢复这份草稿。: This draft cannot be recovered after discarding it.
仅支持 PNG、JPG、WebP 图片: Use PNG, JPG, or WebP images.
剪贴板中没有可粘贴的图片或文字: The clipboard contains no images or text.
单张图片请小于 25 MB: Each image must be smaller than 25 MB.
原记录已删除，请复制内容后新建记录: The original note was deleted. Copy your changes into a new note.
发布所选 {count} 条笔记的内容快照。完成结果可在“Agent 与 MCP: Publish a snapshot of the selected notes ({count}). View the result under Agents and MCP.
将 {count} 条笔记移动到其他项目，内容、图片与引用保留。: Move the selected notes ({count}) to another project. Text, images, and references will move with them.
将删除选中的 {count} 条记录，此操作不可撤销。: The selected notes ({count}) will be deleted permanently.
已发布，agent 可通过 MCP 领取: Task published. An agent can claim it through MCP.
已复制图文 · 粘贴效果由目标软件决定: Text and images copied. Paste behavior depends on the destination app.
希望 agent 完成什么，以及如何验证: Describe what the agent should do and how to verify the result.
当前文字、图片和引用尚未保存。你可以继续编辑，或放弃后关闭窗口。: You have unsaved text, images, or references. Keep editing or discard your changes and close the window.
放弃当前未保存的输入并编辑这条记录？: Discard your unsaved changes and edit this note?
松开，添加图片到笔记: Drop to add images to the note
正在保存或处理图片，请完成后再退出: Wait for saving or image processing to finish before quitting.
正在处理，请稍后再关闭: Wait for the current operation to finish before closing.
正在处理，请稍后再粘贴: Wait for the current operation to finish before pasting.
源内容已变化。重新打开导出窗口即可使用最新内容。: The source has changed. Reopen the export window to use the latest content.
编辑位置已改变，请重新添加图片: The editor changed. Add the images again.
记一句进展，或直接粘贴截图…: Write an update or paste a screenshot…
将下面的配置加入支持本地 MCP 的客户端。无需另外安装 Node，也可以在笔记: Add the configuration below to a client that supports local MCP. Once DevPad is enabled in the client, agents can read notes and images and claim or complete published tasks. This works when the notebook window is closed and requires no separate Node installation.
连接后可访问本机全部笔记；尚未发布的笔记不会出现在可领取任务里。更新后请重连 M: Connected clients can access all local notes. Agents can only claim published tasks. Reconnect your MCP client after updating DevPad.
从笔记菜单或多选工具栏点击“发布任务”。发布内容快照后，后续编辑源笔记不会悄悄改: Choose Publish Task from the note menu or the selection toolbar. The task keeps a snapshot of the notes as they were when you published it.
撤回后，当前 agent 的领取凭证立即失效。: Withdrawing the task immediately revokes the current agent’s claim token.
操作失败，点击重试展开笔记本: Could not expand the notebook. Click to retry.
点「记一条」直接在时间线下方写文字、粘贴截图或拖入图片。保存后可以接着写下一条。: Click Write a note to write below the timeline, paste a screenshot, or drop in images. After saving, you can write another note. Search matches note text, projects, and tags.
点左上角项目名打开项目列表。可以连续查看几个项目，方向键浏览、Enter 切换。: Click the project name in the upper left to open the project list. Use the arrow keys to browse and Enter to switch. In a narrow window, click View Notes to return to the timeline. Drafts stay with their original project.
图文记录默认同时复制正文和图片。粘贴到纯文本框时，图片会显示为原文件名。也可以单: Notes with both text and images copy both by default. In a plain-text field, each image appears as its original filename. You can also copy just the text or just the images. Selected notes are copied in list order. Choose Export… to save the original text and images.
输入会自动存为本地草稿。收起输入区或重新打开 DevPad 后，可以从「继续写草: DevPad saves your input as a local draft. Use Continue Draft after closing the editor or reopening DevPad. Click Save to add the note to the timeline. Use Recover Drafts to recover drafts from separate editor windows.
开发版用于测试新功能，稳定版用于正式发布。后续更新沿用安装位置。旧的独立 EXE: Use the development channel to test new features and the stable channel for official releases. Updates reuse your installation location. If you use the older standalone EXE, migrate to the installed version first.
设置中可复制本机 MCP 配置。普通笔记保持独立；从笔记菜单或多选栏发布任务后，: Copy your local MCP configuration in Settings. Choose Publish Task from the note menu or selection toolbar to let agents claim it, read the original images, and submit results. Disconnect the MCP client before updating DevPad and reconnect afterward.
Windows 用 Ctrl，Mac 用 ⌘。加 N 打开输入，加 Enter: Hold Ctrl on Windows or ⌘ on Mac and press N to start a note, Enter to save, or F to search. Shift-click to select a range. Outside a text field, press Ctrl+A on Windows or ⌘A on Mac to select all current results.
笔记与图片保存在本机。数据位置见设置；备份时应保留数据库与附件目录。: DevPad keeps notes and images on this device. Find the data location in Settings, and include both the database and the attachments folder in your backups.
DevPad 采用 PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0，允: DevPad uses the PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 license, which permits noncommercial use, study, and modification. Third-party dependencies keep their own licenses.
图片加载失败，请关闭后重试: Could not load the image. Close the editor and try again.
关闭后将丢弃这次未应用的标注。: Closing the editor will discard these unapplied annotations.
原图保留，应用后请保存笔记。: The original image is preserved. Save the note after applying annotations.
变量：正文 {{content}}、图片对应 {{image_map}}、项目: Use {{content}} for note text, {{image_map}} for the image list, {{project}} for the project, and {{batch}} for the batch ID. The Original text template adds no instructions.
导出图片添加编号条: Add number bars to exported images
当前已是该通道的最新版本: You have the latest version for this channel
正在保存草稿并准备更新…: Saving drafts and preparing the update…
更新沿用安装位置、快捷方式和本地笔记。安装前保存草稿并备份数据库，完成后重新打开: Updates keep your installation location, shortcuts, and local notes. Save drafts and back up your database before installing. Reopen DevPad when the update finishes.
登录后在系统托盘运行。: Run in the system tray when you sign in.
主窗口置顶: Keep the main window on top
鼠标离开后自动收成悬浮笔记本。: Collapse into a floating notebook when the pointer leaves.
图文复制总量超过 75 MB，请使用完整导出或 MCP: Rich copy exceeds 75 MB. Use full export or MCP.
图片路径无法转换: Could not convert the image path.
清单正文格式错误: Invalid note text in the manifest.
清单图片格式错误: Invalid image list in the manifest.
清单与图片不一致: The manifest does not match the images.
无法注册图文剪贴板格式: Could not register the rich clipboard format.
无效的交付编号，请重新打开交付预览: Invalid delivery number. Reopen the delivery preview.
无法读取交付图片：: Could not read the delivery image:
图片像素过大，请使用较小的图片: The image has too many pixels. Choose a smaller image.
无法创建图片标注画布: Could not create the image label canvas.
无法分配图片标注画布: Could not allocate the image label canvas.
无法读取系统字体: Could not load the system font.
窗口动画尚未就绪，请重试: The window animation is still running. Try again.
请先关闭辅助窗口，再收起笔记本: Close the auxiliary windows before collapsing the notebook.
无法读取收起按钮位置: Could not determine the collapse button position.
请先完成当前操作，再收起笔记本: Finish the current action before collapsing the notebook.
无法读取屏幕位置: Could not determine the screen position.
只有编辑窗口可以保存草稿: Only editor windows can save drafts.
正在处理图片或保存，请稍后再更新: DevPad is processing images or saving. Try updating again in a moment.
正在保存草稿，请稍后再更新: DevPad is saving a draft. Try updating again in a moment.
请输入 1–200 字节的项目名称: Enter a project name between 1 and 200 bytes.
笔记已被其他窗口或 agent 修改或删除。请保留当前草稿，重新打开最新内容后合: Another window or agent changed or deleted this note. Keep your draft and reopen the latest version to merge your changes.
目标项目不存在，请重新选择所属项目: The destination project no longer exists. Choose a different project.
选中的笔记有未保存的编辑，请先保存或关闭对应编辑窗口，再移动项目: Some selected notes have unsaved changes. Save or close their editor windows before moving them.
目标项目不存在，请重新选择: The destination project no longer exists. Choose a different project.
部分笔记已删除，请重新选择后移动: Some notes were deleted. Select the notes again before moving them.
仅支持 PNG、JPG、WebP: Only PNG, JPG and WebP images are supported.
剪贴板文件仅支持 PNG、JPG、WebP 图片: Only PNG, JPG and WebP image files can be pasted.
截图尺寸过大，请裁剪后重试: The screenshot is too large. Crop it and try again.
无法读取截图像素: Could not read the screenshot pixels.
没有图片可复制: There are no images to copy.
MCP 客户端正在使用 DevPad，请先断开该客户端连接，再点击更新；更新后可: An MCP client is using DevPad. Disconnect it before updating, then reconnect when the update finishes.
DevPad · 点击打开，右键退出: DevPad · Click to open, right-click to quit
请先处理所有未保存的笔记: Save or discard all unsaved notes first.
程序路径过长，请移到更短的固定目录后开启: Move DevPad to a shorter permanent path before enabling startup.
任务说明过长: The task instructions are too long.
笔记已删除，请刷新后重试: A note was deleted. Refresh and try again.
更新仓库配置无效: The update repository configuration is invalid.
更新正在进行，请稍后切换通道: An update is in progress. Change channels when it finishes.
正在检查或安装更新: DevPad is checking for or installing an update.
下载或验证更新失败：: Could not download or verify the update:
窗口内容不可用，请关闭后重新打开: Window content is unavailable. Close and reopen the window.
使用已有类型或输入新名称: Choose an existing type or enter a new name
类型名称需为 1–40 个字符: Type names must be 1–40 characters long
搜索正文、标签、项目或图片文件名: Search note text, tags, projects, or image filenames
